notes.title: Distrust Update
notes.notes:
Rescue Operation Center reports the following changes:

 Increased stability of the coop mode
 Network code corrected
 First Aid Kit now includes a secret ingredient that heals cuts
 Minor fixes and improvements

If any failure occurs during the operation "Cooperative game", please contact us directly at ROC. Coordinates of the Center – support@distrust.info

Over!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28830244/ad389da9564d702eed43515c16a39edd4625eaa8.png

notes.title: Distrust Update
notes.notes:
Rescue Operation Center informs:

Now you and your partners can get achievements in COOP mode
Polars from Turkey will find Turkish localization at the base
Crucial number of bugs was fixed by a squad of licensed professionals

Over and out

notes.title: Distrust Update
notes.notes:
Rescue Operation Center informs!
The latest package delivered to the base contains:

The fixed bug that led to an error during a co-op session if a player’s nickname had specific symbols;
A zillion of small, but necessary bugfixes;
The Italian localization provided by Marcello Brancaccio!

Over and out.

notes.title: Distrust Update
notes.notes:
Rescue Operation Center informs:

Multiple incoming messages state that the anomalies have changes their outer appearance. Be careful!
An additional language package featuring Korean language is delivered to the base! NOTE that this localization was prepared by our polar fan Cris Lee.
Closed CO-OP Test will begin in the nearest days. The registration is still open at https://alawar.typeform.com/to/ZutbFX (NB: you must have Distrust in your Steam library to participate).

Over and out.
